aboutUs.title: Building the education platform of the future, together.
aboutUs.description1: We started with a simple observation: most language learning centers and platforms are either boring or offer very limited speaking practice. We built our center to completely close this gap.
aboutUs.description2: Our approach combines advanced teaching methodology with a comfortable, student-focused environment, enabling fluent real-time communication instead of tedious memorization.
aboutUs.card1Desc: Specially designed intensive programs ensure noticeable language progress in a short period.
aboutUs.card2Desc: The main focus of lessons is live communication and speaking, helping to overcome the language barrier in a short time.
aboutUs.card3Desc: We work individually on each student's mistakes and weaknesses, leading them to high results.
aboutUs.locationDesc: We are located in Uzbekistan, Bukhara city, near the "Bukhara State Medical College" complex. Our modern and cozy learning center is always open for you. Come and get to know our learning process up close!
aboutUs.footerTitle: Toward the goal, together, with confidence.
aboutUs.footerDesc: Our team of experienced teachers provides students with continuous support, ensuring they achieve high certifications and a fluent level of communication.

footer.description: Build your future with us. Master modern professions and get quality education.

asilbek.description: I got IELTS 9.0 three times in a row, and honestly, none of it happened by accident. Every session I run is built around one idea — impossible is a word people use before they've tried hard enough. I break down every skill into something manageable, track your weak points relentlessly, and push you past the plateau most students get stuck at. My students don't just pass the exam, they walk out speaking with real confidence. If you're ready to put in the work, I'll make sure the result follows.

ruxillo.description: Ruxillo started learning English on his own while still in school, and within just a few years became one of the most sought-after teachers in his city. He specializes in IELTS preparation and speaking practice, breaking down complex grammar topics into simple, easy-to-understand explanations. Over 4 years of teaching, he has prepared more than 200 students who scored IELTS 7 or higher, and he continues refining his own teaching methodology.

mentorsPage.title: Our Mentor
mentorsPage.subtitle: Learn international-level skills from an experienced English expert.
mentorsPage.bio: Highly qualified expert in English language and IELTS preparation.
mentorsPage.fullBio: Has over 4 years of experience in English teaching and IELTS preparation. Has helped hundreds of students master the language and earn international certificates.

zarnigor.description: Zarnigor scored 8.5 on the international IELTS exam at just 17 years old, a remarkable achievement for her age. She holds a CELTA certificate and specializes in developing speaking skills and refining pronunciation. Zarnigor believes every student can reach a high result if the material is explained clearly and with patience, and that's exactly the approach she brings to every lesson.

gulasal.description: Gulasal holds the maximum IELTS score of 9.0 and a TESOL certificate, qualifying her to teach English at an international level. Over 5 years of practice, she has prepared more than 600 students, many of whom successfully entered universities abroad. Gulasal focuses on academic writing and confident spoken English, helping students not just pass the exam but truly master the language.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Check out the answers to the most common questions from our students.
faq.q1: How long do our courses last?
faq.a1: Depending on the field, our courses last on average from 3 to 12 months. Classes are held 4 times a week by qualified instructors.
faq.q2: What is required to start the classes?
faq.a2: To get started, you only need a laptop (computer), necessary books, internet connection, and a strong desire to learn. Basic knowledge is taught from scratch.
faq.q3: What happens if I miss a class?
faq.a3: Active participation in every class is recommended. If you cannot attend or struggle with a topic, our experienced assistant teachers will help you outside of class hours, re-explain the covered topics, and assist you with practical exercises.
faq.q4: Is a certificate awarded after completing the course?
faq.a4: Yes, graduates who successfully complete the course receive a special certificate, and top students are provided with practical assistance in finding a job.
